title: Solder SMD QFP-32 IC and Clean Flux

transcript.text: We are replacing a QFP-32 microcontroller on board revision 4. First inspect pads under stereo microscope.
Apply a thin line of no-clean tacky flux across all 32 perimeter pads using the syringe dispenser.
Place the IC with anti-static tweezers, aligning pin 1 dot with the silkscreen triangle indicator.
Why tack two corner pins diagonally instead of soldering row by row immediately?
Tacking opposite corners freezes rotational alignment so surface tension doesn't pull the chip askew during drag soldering. Tack pin 1 and diagonally opposite pin 17 with 350C chisel tip.
Perform drag soldering along each row with 0.5 mm lead-free solder wire.
Finally scrub the PCB with 99% isopropyl alcohol and an anti-static brush to remove ionic flux residues.

ground_truth_steps.title: Dispense tacky flux on perimeter pads
ground_truth_steps.instruction: Dispense a uniform ribbon of no-clean tacky flux across all 32 PCB pads.
ground_truth_steps.success_criteria: Continuous thin flux film covers copper pads without excessive pooling.
ground_truth_steps.why: Flux strips copper oxide and facilitates heat transfer to prevent cold joints.

ground_truth_steps.title: Align QFP-32 package to pin 1 index
ground_truth_steps.instruction: Position the chip using ESD tweezers, matching pin 1 orientation dot to board silkscreen.
ground_truth_steps.success_criteria: All 32 IC leads sit squarely centered on copper pads with zero overhang.
ground_truth_steps.why: Misalignment causes adjacent pin shorts or open circuits under BGA/gull-wing thermal stress.

ground_truth_steps.title: Tack diagonal corner pins 1 and 17
ground_truth_steps.instruction: Tack pin 1 then opposite pin 17 with 350C soldering iron tip to lock positioning.
ground_truth_steps.success_criteria: Pins 1 and 17 have shiny concave fillets; remaining pins retain alignment.
ground_truth_steps.why: Tacking opposite corners locks rotational freedom against molten solder surface tension.

ground_truth_steps.title: Drag solder remaining lead rows
ground_truth_steps.instruction: Glide chisel tip along each pin row with slight solder feed.
ground_truth_steps.success_criteria: Every lead features a smooth meniscus solder fillet with zero solder bridges.
ground_truth_steps.why: Drag soldering delivers rapid heat transfer minimizing silicon thermal dwell time.

ground_truth_steps.title: Clean flux residues with IPA
ground_truth_steps.instruction: Clean board area using 99% isopropyl alcohol and ESD nylon brush, then blot dry.
ground_truth_steps.success_criteria: Board surface between leads is crystal clean with zero sticky yellow flux residue.
ground_truth_steps.why: Uncleaned flux attracts moisture and causes electrochemical dendritic migration over time.
